metadata.title: PTM_Pipeline v1.1.0 inputs: source tables and raw downloads behind the Methylarginine Site Explorer
metadata.description:
The inputs of PTM_Pipeline v1.1.0 and of the Methylarginine Site Explorer (https://shechterlab.github.io/PTM_Pipeline/): readable tables and the raw downloads they were made from, so every interaction and annotation layer can be traced to its source and rebuilt offline.

  • ptm_pipeline_inputs_tables_2026-10-20.tar.gz: the inputs/reference, inputs/interactions and inputs/layers folders of the GitHub repository. These are plain tab-separated tables, one per source, each folder with a README and a MANIFEST.tsv (rows, MD5, source URL, version, licence, how made). The UniProt reference is release 2026_03 (reviewed human reference proteome UP000005640, 20,416 sequences).
  • ptm_pipeline_interactions_raw_cache_2026-10-16.tar.gz: the download cache of scripts/37_export_interaction_data.py (36,550 files, saved 16 to 19 October 2026). It holds UniProt, QuickGO, STRING v12.5, Complex Portal, PDBe-KB, SIFTS, RCSB ModelServer neighbourhoods, ProtVar, AlphaFold DB, IntAct, pepR-MS, RBDmap, Trendel et al. 2025 and CD-CODE 2.3. Re-running scripts/37 on it without network access rebuilds the website's interaction data unchanged except for the run date.
  • ptm_pipeline_layers_raw_downloads_2026-10-18.tar.gz: the downloads behind the HPA 25.1 subcellular-location and CARM1-knockout (Shishkova et al. 2017) layers, and the UniProt 2026_03 FASTA with its response headers.
  • README.md, MD5SUMS, SHA256SUMS: contents, licences and checksums.

Each source remains under its own licence, listed in README.md and the MANIFEST files: CC0, CC BY 4.0, EMBL-EBI terms, or CC BY-NC 4.0 (pepR-MS, Trendel et al. 2025, CD-CODE). The combined deposit is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. CPLM 4.0 (all rights reserved) is not included.

Please cite DeAngelo JD, Silverstein AM, Shechter D. Protein arginine methylation rewires molecular interactions. Cell Chem Biol 33(10):1404-1421 (2026), doi:10.1016/j.chembiol.2026.09.011, and the original sources of any data you use.
metadata.notes: Checksums of every raw cached file are in inputs/interactions/raw_cache_files.tsv; the check that the tables hold exactly what the pipeline reads is scripts/37b_check_staged_interactions.py (30 of 30 checks passed on 2026-10-20).
